sha256-fd-v1:c46fc9f411c460d97fc39e039d8.description: Take a series of pop-culture and science-fiction quizzes to gain entry to Cybernetic Hi-School. Version 2.0 revises the original with its own boot system, larger graphics, and faster presentation.
sha256-fd-v1:c46fc9f411c460d97fc39e039d8.title: Dennou Gakuen: Version 2.0

sha256-fd-v1:c48ba2b749a256951a98d89a08e.description: Siblings Meena and Otto can channel spiritual energy into magic. A request to gather healing plants leads them into a trap in a forest, beginning a fantasy RPG journey.
sha256-fd-v1:c48ba2b749a256951a98d89a08e.title: Wind's Seed

sha256-hdi-v1:c41f1b2fd3f66518bdf096e143.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 06

sha256-hdi-v1:c4dd65fe4691d8573650ded9ef.description: Bass's stomach escapes on its own, sending the group after it in the seventh Jewel Bem Hunter Lime episode. The story unfolds through brief animated scenes.
